axisymmetric line-integration physics, selected Hansen-Law first-order hold
method, the exact bound synthetic observations, float64 output of shape
(1,65,257) in radiance/mm, and upstream-derived metric boundaries. Synthetic

redistribution rights was established in this search. No experimental-fidelity
claim is made.

units, with axes (batch,z,y). `evaluation/ground_truth.npz` contains actual
analytic synthetic emission under key `reconstruction`, float64, same shape
but axes (batch,z,r), radiance/mm. It is not an upstream reconstruction.
No `baseline_reference.npz` is supplied because actual simulation truth exists.

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains only the following visible array. Load with `allow_pickle=False`.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| projection | (1, 65, 257) | float64 | Observed line-integrated brightness in relative radiance units; axes are (batch, z, y), with y increasing away from the symmetry axis. |

### Acquisition metadata

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Batch size | 1 | dimensionless | One stationary acquisition |
| Axial sample count | 65 | dimensionless | Number of independent detector rows |
| Radial sample count | 257 | dimensionless | Samples on the right half, including the axis |
| Impact/radial spacing | 0.025 | mm | Same spacing for detector y and reconstruction r |
| Axial spacing | 0.1 | mm | Increasing row index increases z |
| Impact/radial coordinate | y(j)=r(j)=j*0.025, j=0,...,256 | mm | Axis is at the center of column zero; no half-pixel offset |
| Axial coordinate | z(i)=(i-32)*0.1, i=0,...,64 | mm | Row 32 is z=0 |
| Maximum impact/radius | 6.4 | mm | Last detector/reconstruction sample |
| Axial interval | [-3.2, 3.2] | mm | First and last axial sample |
| Detector noise standard deviation | 0.002 | relative radiance units | Independent additive normal noise per sample; zero mean |
| Detector response | 1 | dimensionless | Calibrated linear response; no blur or offset |
| Sampling convention | Point samples | dimensionless | Brightness evaluated at pixel centers, rather than integrated over pixel area |
| Symmetry | Cylindrical about z | dimensionless | Left half would contain the same ideal projection; no axial symmetry is imposed |
| Line-of-sight boundaries | Infinite line, negligible source tail outside detector radius | dimensionless | No periodic boundaries; optical absorption and scattering neglected |

references:
- Published method: Constable, S. C., Parker, R. L., and Constable, C. G. (1987), *Occam's inversion: A practical algorithm for generating smooth models from electromagnetic sounding data*, Geophysics 52(3),289–300, final published paper, DOI https://doi.org/10.1190/1.1442303. Author-hosted paper https://marineemlab.ucsd.edu/~steve/bio/Occam1D.pdf, privately archived as `Constable1987.pdf`, SHA256 `9d9a4928a8f3dc0bfa83e042e99a185627b855a8a64d945f52f836446cacf8da`. The PDF is not redistributed in the task.
- Original implementation: Dong Hao (2011), https://github.com/dong-hao/occam1dmt . Exact commit **2b4e2e1e85182dd382a558f34ab2d8630ec22c53**, both clone HEAD and actual remote `git ls-remote origin HEAD` verified in this session on 2026-10-21; no claim based only on tracking metadata. The source `LICENSE` is **AGPL-3.0**, despite README's looser GPL-v3 wording. Preserve this actual license at task level. Local `physics_model.py` and `solvers.py` explicitly attribute Dong Hao and adaptations. The complete original checkout and corrected copy remain private, never imported by tests/runtime/notebook.
- Existing real observations: original repository `examples/aushield.dat`, 23 published numeric rows copied by its author from Table5 of the paper, originating in Cull (1985), *Magnetotelluric soundings over a Precambrian contact in Australia*, GJRAS80,661–675. Source numeric data file is distributed with the repository's AGPL3 license; no separate restrictive data notice occurs in the checkout. Only numeric observations are repackaged, with attribution; the copyrighted paper is kept privately. No new simulation, hidden seed, synthetic object, target-derived calibration, or hidden extra observation is released.
- Data SHA256, exact source bytes: `95124150da6d3ad6e342915dd7da8119d92de809a950a014d95335e05e5c5a5a`. Source discretization `examples/aushield.mod` SHA256 `103c74fc8b1bf860b2e7528fc2c3d83741c0085f1d230fd30b15a49c6b0f0f73`. The depth column in that file is a list of **thicknesses**, despite its heading `layerdepth`; the original testbench computes cumulative layer tops. We do exactly that, preserving every stored decimal and float64. Last row gives a half-space; its zero thickness is not included in cumulative tops.
- Bound public NPZ SHA256 `d243817ab3873e312647d18c661954d99424abb0ad1b08bbf8db5425a908dea7`. Raw numeric observations remain float64; source phases/phase standard deviations are converted degrees to radians once, using the original pi/180 convention. No downcast occurs. Source error on log apparent resistivity is already in log10 units and is not divided by rho again.
- Novelty versus all119 preexisting task names reviewed before reservation: this reconstructs a **25-layer depth-resistivity spatial field from diffusive electric/magnetic impedance**. It is not existing EIT's boundary-voltage geometry, seismic travel-time/receiver-function inverse, or gravity continuation. The layer grid is a public discretization, not evidence of 25 resolved independent geological layers.

Fresh standard measured values (full precision): `{"ncc": 1.0000000000000002, "nrmse": 1.3919241177421061e-15, "observation_rms": 0.8436476413023603}`. NCC uses flattened cosine similarity **without centering**. NRMSE uses RMS error divided by the reference dynamic range. No mask, scaling, crop, shift or phase adjustment occurs. Tiny NCC overshoot1.0000000000000002 is floating-point roundoff in cosine calculation, not a nonstandard definition.

Because the method itself supplies the reference, self-error zero is unsuitable for a literal1.1-times-zero threshold. Independent corrected-original reruns are identical here; NumPy/Octave parity gives NRMSE1.3919241177421061e-15. Set nonzero NRMSE tolerance1e-7 and NCC>=.999999999, comfortably above measured double precision discrepancies while still rejecting a poor uniform profile. Also require standardized **physical observation RMS<=1.0**, the original discrepancy target, computed independently in the Judge from the public period/depth/response arrays. This prevents treating arbitrary reference similarity as physical consistency. Reference agreement is not geological accuracy. All25 spatial entries and both observation channels are evaluated.
data_source.description:
All arrays are stored in `data/raw_data.npz` with an explicit batch axis.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| period | (1, 23) | float64 | Measured sounding periods, seconds. |
| log_apparent_resistivity | (1, 23) | float64 | Observed log10(apparent resistivity / (1 ohm metre)), dimensionless. |
| log_resistivity_std | (1, 23) | float64 | Standard deviations of log10 apparent resistivity, dimensionless. |
| impedance_phase | (1, 23) | float64 | Observed impedance phase in the convention defined above, radians. |
| phase_std | (1, 23) | float64 | Standard deviations of impedance phase, radians. |
| layer_top | (1, 25) | float64 | Reconstruction layer-top depths, metres, positive downward. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vacuum permeability | 4 pi times 10^-7 | H/m | Nonmagnetic constitutive parameter. |
| Surface depth | 0 | m | Plane-wave observation boundary. |
| Number of periods | 23 | 1 | Paired apparent-resistivity and phase observations. |
| Period range | 0.020 to 1995.000 | s | Actual irregular sampling is in `period`. |
| Number of layers | 25 | 1 | Piecewise constant profile; deepest layer extends to infinity. |
| Layer axes | Horizontal planes; positive depth downward | 1 | One-dimensional Earth geometry, no lateral variation. |
| Source and medium | Plane-wave source; isotropic conductive layers | 1 | Quasistatic magnetic diffusion model. |
| Bottom boundary | Homogeneous half-space | 1 | Decaying solution, C=1/q in the final layer. |
| Noise weighting | Provided marginal standard deviations; diagonal weighting assumed | 1 | Separate uncertainty scales; cross-channel covariance is unavailable. |
| Complex convention | q=sqrt(i omega mu / rho), Re(q)>0 | 1 | Fixes phase and attenuation signs. |

The arrays retain the numerical precision of the published tabulation. The layer grid is a chosen spatial discretization, not a target-derived calibration. No additional input files are required.

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |

| Free boundary condition | sigma times outward normal=0 | kPa micrometres | Both normal and tangential boundary tractions vanish. |
| Traction sign | monolayer force on substrate | 1 | The stress divergence equals traction, not its negative. |

| Original added relative noise | 5% | 1 | Author-provided simulated measurement noise; component covariance not specified. |
| Temporal samples | 1 | frame | Static spatial reconstruction. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Organism | B. subtilis | dimensionless identifier | Author-described motile bacterial sample. |
| Temperature | 33 | degrees Celsius | Author-reported acquisition temperature. |
| Frame rate fs | 100 | Hz | All 2000 frames retained for each condition. |
| Pixel spacing | 75.59/128 = 0.590546875 | micrometers/pixel | Exact calibration used in the supplied analysis; its text rounds this to 0.591. |
| Native dimensions | 128 by 128 | pixels | Finite camera field, 75.59 micrometers on each side. |
| Intensity encoding | unsigned 8 bit | ADU | Native detector values; no photon conversion or measured noise variance supplied. |
| Optical context | point-scanning confocal, 63x oil objective | dimensionless identifier | Author-reported instrument context. |
| Focal conditions | native identifiers 01umE and 16umE | dimensionless identifiers | Two distinct focal conditions; no independently verified metric depth is imposed. |
| Spatial Fourier boundary | periodic discrete basis, no window or padding | pixels | FFT applied to the entire finite field; normalization 1/sqrt(128*128). |
| Wavevector coordinates | kx=2pi*fftfreq(128)[:65]/pixel_spacing; ky=2pi*fftshift(fftfreq(128))/pixel_spacing | rad/micrometer | Real-FFT half-plane, x unshifted and y shifted. |
| Radial edges | 90 equally spaced values from 0 to 90*2pi/75.59 | rad/micrometer | Bin index is left search insertion index of the mode radius in these edges. |
| Ring weights | 2 except x DC/Nyquist columns 1 | dimensionless | Full-plane multiplicity of each stored Fourier mode. |
| Excluded Fourier modes | first x column, central y row, insertion index >=90 | dimensionless indices | Fixed cross mask; no target-dependent mask. |
| Ring center and output selection | weighted mean mode radius; retain centers 0.75 through 4 | rad/micrometer | Ascending selected centers define the 39 output positions. |
| Delay averaging | all T-l overlapping pairs | frame pairs | No temporal wrapping or padded pairs contribute. |

references:
- Method repository: https://github.com/fatiando/harmonica, release v0.7.0, exact revision `b9f9c00b0999f470dcae971b19add28b055633c9`.
- Remote revision evidence: downloaded https://codeload.github.com/fatiando/harmonica/zip/refs/tags/v0.7.0; archive ZIP comment records that full commit. This is verification of the published tag archive, not a claim that the current branch is fresh. Git ls-remote failed through intermittent network reset and API was rate limited. The unrelated downloaded main archive is not method provenance.
- Unmodified upstream run: PyPI Harmonica 0.7.0 installed privately. Its `_equivalent_sources/cartesian.py` and `_equivalent_sources/utils.py` bytes were separately hashed and are identical to the tag archive. The exact solver stage also uses Verde 1.9.0 `verde.base.least_squares` and scikit-learn Ridge, whose environment is frozen privately. These dependencies never enter the cleaned runtime.
- Paper: Soler, S. R. and Uieda, L. (2021), *Gradient-boosted equivalent sources*, DOI https://doi.org/10.1093/gji/ggab297. Inspected author-accepted manuscript: https://eartharxiv.org/repository/object/2111/download/5366/, DOI https://doi.org/10.31223/X58G7C, accepted 2021 July 27, received 2021 February 21. PDF explicitly states author-accepted, pre-copyedited and CC-BY-4.0. Selected method is Sections 2.1-2.2 equations (1)-(10), the standard full damped solve; subsequent boosting/block-averaging sections are not implemented or claimed. The paper/source provide independent executable mathematics rather than a wrapper.
- Dataset: Bushveld gravity version 1, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6511942; bytes downloaded from https://zenodo.org/records/6511942/files/bushveld-gravity.csv.xz?download=1.
- Official preparation/documentation: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fatiando-data/bushveld-gravity/v1/README.md, archived as data-readme.md. The redistributed data are CC-BY-4.0, distinct from the original NOAA NCEI/ETOPO1 public-domain sources. the consolidated attribution section of this validation record credits both levels. Method extraction preserves BSD-3-Clause copyright in modules and the consolidated licensing section of this validation record.
- Survey source has 3877 real stations. Inclusive geographic crop 27.5 <= longitude <= 29 and -25.5 <= latitude <= -24.5 retains all 306 stations in source order. No synthetic observations or noise are generated, so there is no src/generate_data.py. The source observation is `gravity_disturbance_mgal`, derived upstream by normal-gravity subtraction. It is not Bouguer-corrected and not raw gravimeter counts.
- Source station coordinates were projected privately using pyproj 3.7.2 from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32735 with always_xy=True, then horizontal offsets 600000 m and 7200000 m were subtracted. Source `height_geometric_m` is retained; the distributor formed it from supplied mean-sea-level heights plus interpolated geoid heights. It is not target-derived calibration. The target plane is a requested geometry, not a hidden field measurement. Projection has no runtime dependency.

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frames | 3000 | frame | Full temporal extent, 100 seconds nominally |
| Frame rate | 30 | Hz | Nominal rate distributed with the reference acquisition configuration |
| Frame dimensions | 170 by 170 | pixel | Rows increase downward, columns increase rightward |
| Pixel pitch | 2 by 2 | micrometre/pixel | Nominal metadata; not independently instrument calibrated |
| Indicator decay time | 0.4 | s | Nominal transient timescale supplied with the acquisition configuration |
| Native intensity | arbitrary signed fluorescence counts | count | No absolute photon conversion available |
| Intensity offset | minus minimum of frames 0 through 399 | count | Observation-derived offset, no target dependence |
| Rigid search support | row and column displacement from -6 to +6 | pixel | Admissible global motion support |
| Nonrigid grid windows | starts 0, 50, 96 along each axis; window size 74 | pixel | Nine overlapping windows; enumeration row-start outer loop, column-start inner loop |
| Nonrigid deviation support | plus or minus 3 from the rigid estimate | pixel | Local displacement support |
| Motion precision | 0.1 | pixel | Subpixel Fourier registration resolution |
| Motion sign | positive moves image content down/right | pixel | Image-content correction, row then column; source sampling has opposite sign |
| Motion boundaries | copy nearest valid edge | none | Cubic warp with replicated boundary values; no periodic image wrap |
| Background rank | 2 | component | Diffuse low-rank fluorescence contribution |
| Noise | unknown, estimated per pixel/trace | count RMS | Frequency band 0.25 to 0.5 cycles per frame is available for stationary noise estimation |

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Echo times | Stored individually, 256 values | s | Native irregular logarithmic echo schedule |
| Quadrature convention | real + i imaginary | a.u. | Coherent transverse magnetization signal |

| First echo treatment | Discard zero-based echo 0 after phasing | 1 | Preserves author treatment of initial echo artifact |
| Relaxation grid | 10^(-5+5j/254), j=0..254 | s | Discrete exponential model required for output interpretation |
| Scans | 120 | 1 | Complete OPC example, filename-sorted acquisition order |
| Offset model | 0 | a.u. | Complex-acquisition branch has no magnitude offset |
| Noise variance | Not supplied | a.u.² | No known Gaussian uncertainty is asserted |
| Boundary | No contribution outside relaxation grid | 1 | Finite-grid inversion assumption |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains the complete reduced 500 point absorption spectrum and the nominal copper theoretical scattering functions. The latter are a published elemental/nominal-lattice model, not calibration fitted using this foil's unknown distance or variance.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| k | (1, 500) | float64 | Experimental photoelectron wavenumber, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, measurement). |
| chi | (1, 500) | float64 | Background-subtracted, edge-step-normalized measured EXAFS oscillation, dimensionless; axes (batch, measurement). |
| scattering_k | (1, 59) | float64 | Theoretical scattering table wavenumber, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, table sample). |
| scattering_phase | (1, 59) | float64 | Total central-plus-scattering phase shift delta, radian; axes (batch, table sample). |
| scattering_amplitude | (1, 59) | float64 | Effective single-path scattering amplitude including reduction factor, Angstrom; axes (batch, table sample). |
| real_momentum | (1, 59) | float64 | Real part of complex photoelectron momentum, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, table sample). |
| mean_free_path | (1, 59) | float64 | Photoelectron coherence mean free path, Angstrom; axes (batch, table sample). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sample | rolled and annealed copper foil | — | Observed material identified in original data header. |
| Temperature | 10 | K | Stated measurement temperature. |
| Absorption edge | Cu K | — | Copper core excitation. |
| Nominal scan edge | 8980.0 | eV | Energy reference stated in acquisition header. |
| Reduction edge origin | 8982.61 | eV | Origin used by the published reduced k coordinate. |
| Edge step | 2.257 | dimensionless absorption | Normalization stated in original reduced data header. |
| Monochromator | two Si(111) crystals | — | Instrument configuration stated in original data header. |
| Nominal shell distance R0 | 2.5478 | Angstrom | Reference geometry for supplied theoretical Cu–Cu path. |
| Path degeneracy | 12 | neighbors | Assumed first-shell coordination, not estimated from the hidden target. |
| Higher cumulants | zero | Angstrom^3 and Angstrom^4 | Gaussian first-shell model convention. |
| Extra broadening energy | zero | eV | No adjustable additional lifetime broadening. |
| Radial convention | positive absorber–neighbor separation | Angstrom | Isotropic ensemble first-shell radial density. |
| Uncertainty information | no pointwise standard errors supplied | — | Equal k-space uncertainty weighting defines a fit normalization, not a measured noise estimate. |
| Background status | published reduced chi(k) | dimensionless | Atomic background and edge normalization already applied; no raw detector counts are required. |

# Reference Materials

## Core Algorithms

- **Chambolle-Pock (PDHG):** Chambolle, A. and Pock, T. (2011). "A first-order primal-dual algorithm for convex problems with applications to imaging." *JMIV*, 40(1), 120-145. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10851-010-0251-1
- **TV-regularized CT:** Sidky, E.Y. and Pan, X. (2008). "Image reconstruction in circular cone-beam computed tomography by constrained, total-variation minimization." *PMB*, 53(17), 4777. https://doi.org/10.1088/0031-9155/53/17/021

## Software

- **scikit-image radon/iradon:** https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/auto_examples/transform/plot_radon_transform.html
- **DIVal (Deep Inversion Validation Library):** https://github.com/jleuschn/dival — provides CT benchmark datasets and reconstruction baselines (our task uses the same Shepp-Logan phantom paradigm but implements transforms via scikit-image for CPU portability)
- **ASTRA Toolbox:** https://www.astra-toolbox.com/ — GPU-accelerated CT reconstruction (not used here due to macOS/CPU constraint, but the standard reference for production CT)

## Phantom

- **Shepp-Logan phantom:** Shepp, L.A. and Logan, B.F. (1974). "The Fourier reconstruction of a head section." *IEEE TNS*, 21(3), 21-43.

references: Phase-shifted fringe images from two cameras observing a ThorLabs LE1234-A biconvex lens.
data_source.description:
### `data/raw_data.npz`

Phase-shifted fringe images from two cameras observing a ThorLabs LE1234-A biconvex lens.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `imgs` | `(1, 3, 8, 2, 2048, 2048)` | `float32` | Measurement images with lens in place; axes: (batch, sinusoid_periods, phase_shifts, cameras, H, W). 3 periods (T = 70, 100, 110 px), 8 shifts per period (4 for x-direction + 4 for y-direction), 2 cameras. Intensity in arbitrary units. |
| `refs` | `(1, 3, 8, 2, 2048, 2048)` | `float32` | Reference images without lens (same axes as `imgs`). Used to extract differential phase. Intensity in arbitrary units. |

### `data/ground_truth.npz`

Manufacturer-specified lens parameters for the ThorLabs LE1234-A.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `surface_0_roc_mm` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Radius of curvature of the first lens surface in mm |
| `surface_1_roc_mm` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Radius of curvature of the second lens surface in mm |
| `thickness_mm` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Centre thickness of the lens in mm |

### Other data files

- `data/calibration/`: Camera intrinsics/extrinsics, rotation calibration, gamma-correction LUTs (MATLAB `.mat` files).
- `data/lenses/ThorLabs/LE1234-A.txt`: Zemax-format lens prescription (surface curvatures, thicknesses, materials).
- `data/sinusoids/`: Display fringe pattern images at period T = 70 px.
- `data/meta_data.json`: Imaging parameters (sensor size, display pixel pitch, sinusoid periods) and calibration settings. Does not contain solver parameters.

data_source.description:
### data/raw_data.npz

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `dwi_signal` | `(1, 128, 128, 31)` | float32 | Diffusion-weighted MRI signal (a.u.) at 1 b=0 + 30 gradient directions |
| `bvals` | `(31,)` | float32 | b-values in s/mm² (0 for b=0 volumes, 1000 for DWI) |
| `bvecs` | `(31, 3)` | float32 | Gradient direction unit vectors (zero vector for b=0) |

### data/ground_truth.npz

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `fa_map` | `(1, 128, 128)` | float32 | Ground truth fractional anisotropy map (dimensionless, 0–1) |
| `md_map` | `(1, 128, 128)` | float32 | Ground truth mean diffusivity map (mm²/s) |
| `tensor_elements` | `(1, 128, 128, 6)` | float32 | Ground truth tensor elements [Dxx, Dxy, Dxz, Dyy, Dyz, Dzz] (mm²/s) |
| `tissue_mask` | `(1, 128, 128)` | bool | Binary tissue mask (True where tissue is present) |

### data/meta_data.json

| Key | Type | Description |
|-----|------|-------------|
| `image_size` | int | Image dimension (128) |
| `n_directions` | int | Number of DWI gradient directions (30) |
| `n_b0` | int | Number of b=0 volumes (1) |
| `b_value_s_per_mm2` | float | b-value for DWI volumes (1000.0 s/mm²) |
| `noise_sigma` | float | Rician noise standard deviation (0.02) |
| `signal_model` | str | Signal model type ("stejskal_tanner") |
| `modality` | str | Imaging modality |
| `field_of_view_mm` | float | Field of view in mm (220.0) |
| `pixel_size_mm` | float | Pixel size in mm |

The synthetic data is generated from a modified Shepp-Logan phantom with diffusion tensor properties assigned per tissue region: bone/scalp (low MD, low FA), white matter (moderate MD, high FA with directional fibers), gray matter (moderate MD, low FA), deep gray matter (intermediate FA), and CSF (high MD, isotropic).

data_source.description:
All 496 diffusion encodings are included. Spatial slices are original zero-based indices 8, 9, and 10; the full 96 by 96 detector field is retained. Data are the deposited magnitude observations without additional denoising, motion correction, resampling, or synthesized noise.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| signals | (1, 3, 96, 96, 496) | int16 | MRI magnitude observations, ADU; axes batch, native slice, native x, native y, encoding |
| bvalues | (1, 496) | float64 | Diffusion weighting in s per mm squared, matched to encoding axis |
| gradient_directions | (1, 496, 3) | float64 | Unitless Cartesian encoding direction components from deposited table; zero for b=0 |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scanner | Siemens Trio | dimensionless | Human 3 T system |
| Field strength | 3 | tesla | Static magnetic field |
| Receiver | 32-channel head coil | channel | Acquisition receiver |
| Sequence | Double-spin-echo diffusion EPI with CSF suppression | dimensionless | Magnitude image acquisition |
| b shells | 0; 200 through 3000 in increments of 200 | s/mm squared | One b=0 image and 33 directions at every nonzero shell |
| Voxel spacing | 2.5, 2.5, 2.500000476837158 | mm | Stored native NIfTI x,y,z spacing, including original precision |
| Repetition time | 7200 | ms | TR |
| Echo time | 116 | ms | TE |
| Inversion time | 2100 | ms | CSF suppression TI |
| Original volume | 96 by 96 by 19 | voxel | Native geometry |
| Included slices | 8, 9, 10 | zero-based index | Three central native planes, no in-plane crop |
| Phase encoding | Anterior to posterior | dimensionless | EPI acquisition direction |
| Angular sampling | 24-point spherical design plus 9 fast-kurtosis directions | dimensionless | 33-direction shell sampling; use supplied vectors |
| Reported b=0 SNR | Approximately 39 | dimensionless | Depositor tissue-average estimate; no per-voxel noise standard deviation supplied |
| Spatial boundary | Independent voxel estimation | dimensionless | No spatial interpolation or wraparound |

Native voxel indices (i,j,k) map to world millimeters through the acquisition affine below; k takes values 8,9,10 for the output slices. Vector components follow the deposited encoding table and are used only for identifying directional sampling; the powder-average inverse is rotationally invariant.

```math
\begin{pmatrix}X\\Y\\Z\\1\end{pmatrix}=
\begin{pmatrix}
-2.497706413269043&0.08375494927167892&0.06668981164693832&113.64055633544922\\
0.069154292345047&2.4509189128875732&-0.4880725145339966&-104.14154052734375\\
0.0817319005727768&0.48577991127967834&2.4509875774383545&-31.504009246826172\\
0.0&0.0&0.0&1.0
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}i\\j\\k\\1\end{pmatrix}.
```

X,Y,Z denote world coordinates; i,j,k denote native zero-based voxel indices. Absolute orientation is not an evaluation alignment degree of freedom.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| measurements | (1, 64, 1600) | float64 | Native calibrated EEG potentials inV; electrode then time order |
| lead_field | (1, 64, 789) | float64 | Independent conductor response inV/(A m); columns node-major then x/y/z |
| positions | (1, 263, 3) | float64 | Source-node x/y/z coordinates in m, approximate head frame |
| electrodes | (1, 64, 3) | float64 | Template electrode x/y/z coordinates in m, same frame and row order as potentials |
| times | (1, 1600) | float64 | Time from the recording start in s |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sampling rate | 160 | Hz | Original recording sampling frequency |
| Bound interval | 0 through 9.99375 | s | First 1600 samples; no temporal decimation |
| Electrode count | 64 | channel | Complete measured EEG channels, original order |
| Experimental run | subject001, run04 | identifier | Imagined unilateral fist movement protocol; segment may include rest |
| Montage | standard1005 template matched to original10-10 labels | dimensionless | Approximate coordinates, no individual digitization |
| Conductor center | (0,0,0.04) | m | Independent spherical head-model center |
| Outer radius | 0.09 | m | Spherical scalp radius |
| Shell relative radii | 0.90,0.92,0.97,1.0 | dimensionless | Four-shell geometry |
| Shell conductivities | 0.33,1.0,0.004,0.33 | S/m | Independent conductivity approximation |
| Source grid pitch | 0.015 | m | Cartesian spatial sampling |
| Source sphere radius | 0.065 | m | Candidate source-volume radius |
| Source center exclusion | 0.010 | m | Fixed minimum radial source distance |
| Source boundary clearance | 0.005 | m | Source sphere boundary margin |
| Reference | arithmetic electrode average | V | P removes the unobservable potential offset |
| Boundary model | quasi-static four-shell sphere in insulating exterior | dimensionless | No individual MRI anatomy assumed |
| Noise variance | not independently measured | unavailable | Regularization uses an explicitly assumed isotropic covariance, not a measured calibration |

### `data/raw_data.npz`

Pre-processed observation arrays from a real SgrA* 2015 ALMA VLBI observation:

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `vis` | (938,) | complex128 | Complex visibilities |
| `sigma` | (938,) | float64 | Per-visibility thermal noise sigma (Jy) |
| `uv_coords` | (938, 2) | float64 | Baseline (u, v) coordinates in wavelengths |
| `times` | (938,) | float64 | Observation times |
| `t1`, `t2` | (938,) | bytes | Station names for each baseline |
| `station_ids` | (938, 2) | int64 | Integer station pair indices |
| `cp_times` | (465,) | float64 | Closure phase timestamps |
| `cp_t1`, `cp_t2`, `cp_t3` | (465,) | bytes | Closure triangle station names |
| `cp_values_deg` | (465,) | float64 | Observed closure phases (degrees) |
| `cp_sigmas_deg` | (465,) | float64 | Closure phase sigmas (degrees) |
| `lca_times` | (485,) | float64 | Log closure amplitude timestamps |
| `lca_t1`, `lca_t2`, `lca_t3`, `lca_t4` | (485,) | bytes | Closure quad station names |
| `lca_values` | (485,) | float64 | Observed log closure amplitudes |
| `lca_sigmas` | (485,) | float64 | Log closure amplitude sigmas |

> **Note**: `raw_data.npz` was created from the original `obs.uvfits` file using
> `ehtim >= 1.2` and `astropy >= 4.0`. Those packages are NOT required at runtime;
> they are only needed if you want to re-generate `raw_data.npz` from the original
> FITS/UVFITS files (see `src/generate_data.py`).

### `data/ground_truth.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `image` | (32, 32) | float64 | Ground-truth image regridded to 32×32, 160 μas FOV |

> Regridded from the original 128×128 FITS reference image using ehtim.

### `data/meta_data.json`

JSON file with imaging and training parameters:
- `npix` = 32: image size (32×32 pixels)
- `fov_uas` = 160.0: field of view in microarcseconds
- `prior_fwhm_uas` = 50.0: Gaussian prior FWHM in microarcseconds
- `n_flow` = 16: number of Real-NVP flow blocks
- `n_epoch` = 10000: training epochs
- `batch_size` = 32: mini-batch size
- `lr` = 1e-4: Adam learning rate
- `logdet_weight` = 1.0: entropy term weight
- `l1_weight`, `tsv_weight`, `flux_weight`, `center_weight`, `mem_weight`: prior weights
- `grad_clip` = 0.1: gradient clipping threshold

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains the original repository's already binned/cropped, real acquired intensity images, repackaged without numerical modification. Load with `allow_pickle=False`. Both keys are available at acquisition time; the vacuum image is calibration, not a target reconstruction.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| hologram | (1, 512, 512) | int64 | Object hologram intensity, detector counts; axes (batch,y,x). |
| vacuum | (1, 512, 512) | int64 | Separately recorded vacuum hologram intensity, detector counts; axes (batch,y,x). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sample | Fe needle with YOx nanoparticle inclusions | dimensionless label | Material specimen; YOx indicates yttrium oxide without specified stoichiometry. |
| Instrument | FEI Titan G2 60-300 HOLO at ER-C | dimensionless label | Transmission electron microscope. |
| Beam energy | 300 | keV | Electron kinetic energy. |
| Exposure | 10 | s | Exposure for each image. |
| Biprism voltage | 130 | V | Interference acquisition setting. |
| Stage tilt | 5 | degree | Recorded specimen-stage tilt. |
| Pixel size d | 0.9197516441345215 | nm/pixel | Same square sample-plane spacing in both images. |
| x origin | 0 | nm | Physical x coordinate of column zero. |
| y origin | 183.9503288269043 | nm | Physical y coordinate of row zero. |
| Axis order | y increases with row, x increases with column | dimensionless convention | Retain supplied image orientation. |
| Dimensions Ny,Nx | 512,512 | pixel | No additional cropping or resampling. |
| Observed carrier ky,kx | 122,454 | DFT bin | Peak in the unshifted vacuum DFT; kx=454 is equivalent to -58. |
| Intensity calibration | gain-normalized detector counts | count | No absolute electron-count conversion is provided. |
| Noise model | not independently calibrated | dimensionless description | Retain measured noise; do not assume a supplied Gaussian variance. |
| Boundary convention | periodic DFT extension | dimensionless convention | Fourier filtering uses the complete supplied images. |

The sample's mean inner potential, thickness and charge density are not supplied or required for wave reconstruction. The table reports the binned/cropped images' calibrated axes rather than the original camera frame's pixel spacing.

data_source.description:
All arrays follow the imaging-101 batch-first convention: the leading axis
has length 1 (single sample).

### `data/raw_data.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `obs_history` | (1, 5, 50, 64, 32) | float32 | Normalised noisy observation history; axis order `(sample, T, history_len*C, H, W)`. The 50 channels are 10 successive observation timesteps stacked over the 5 physical channels (geopotential, temperature, humidity, wind_u, wind_v). Per-channel min–max normalised to ≈ [0, 1]. |
| `max_val` | (1, 5) | float32 | Per-channel maximum used for de-normalisation. Order matches `meta_data.json::channels`. Units: `m^2/s^2`, `K`, `kg/kg`, `m/s`, `m/s`. |
| `min_val` | (1, 5) | float32 | Per-channel minimum used for de-normalisation. Same channel order and units as `max_val`. |
| `lat_weight_matrix` | (1, 5, 64, 32) | float32 | Cosine-latitude weighting tiled over the 5 physical channels and the 64×32 grid (dimensionless). Used by the weighted-NRMSE metric. |

### `data/ground_truth.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `state` | (1, 5, 5, 64, 32) | float32 | True state sequence in the same normalised space as the observations. Axis order `(sample, T, C, H, W)`. Per-channel range ≈ [0, 1]. |

### `data/meta_data.json`

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `n_channels` | 5 | Number of physical channels per state field. |
| `channels` | `["geopotential", "temperature", "humidity", "wind_u", "wind_v"]` | Channel order for `state`, `max_val`, `min_val`, `lat_weight_matrix`. |
| `channel_units` | `["m^2/s^2", "K", "kg/kg", "m/s", "m/s"]` | Physical units (post-denormalisation). |
| `grid_height` | 64 | Number of longitude grid points. |
| `grid_width` | 32 | Number of latitude grid points. |
| `history_len` | 10 | Number of observation timesteps stacked into one inverse-obs network input. |
| `ass_T` | 5 | Number of timesteps assimilated per sample. |
| `longitude_resolution_deg` | 5.625 | 360 / 64. |
| `latitude_resolution_deg` | 5.625 | 180 / 32. |
| `dataset_source` | string | Provenance: ERA5 reanalysis via the Tensor-Var release. |

`meta_data.json` contains imaging geometry only — solver hyperparameters
(assimilation window length, seed, sample index, QP backend) live as named
constants in `main.py` to avoid leaking algorithm details to the evaluation
agent.

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input frequency convention | Cycles per second | Hz | Use omega=2πf |
| Analysis band | 10 to 5000 | Hz | Closest stored bins; upper cutoff is exclusive before fitting |
| Transfer quantity | Accelerance | m/(N s²) | Measured acceleration divided by force |
| Time convention | Laplace s=i omega | 1 | Stable poles have negative real part |
| Response reference | Index 1 in original seven-response author dataset | 1 | Entire six-excitation acquisition for that fixed response |
| Spatial axis | Roving excitation index 0..5 | 1 | No physical coordinate scale is supplied |
| Model size | Seven conjugate-paired flexible modes | 1 | All seven mode quantities are required |
| Fitted output grid | Prepend zero frequency, retain native bins before closest 5000 Hz bin | Hz | 4999 entries; zero-padding convention is explicit |
| Noise covariance | Not supplied | 1 | Unweighted frequency-domain model |

data_source.description:
All visible arrays are in `data/raw_data.npz` and retain original float64 channel values. The complex polarization stores the original Q and U values without averaging or resampling.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| frequency | (1, 288) | float64 | Increasing channel centre frequency in Hz; axes (batch, channel). |
| polarization | (1, 288) | complex128 | Q + i U flux density in Jy/beam; axes (batch, channel). |
| noise | (1, 288) | float64 | One standard deviation of each independent Q and U noise component, Jy/beam; axes (batch, channel). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Observation type | Supplied simulated radio polarization spectrum | — | Existing observations, not a real sky measurement. |
| Channel count | 288 | channels | All distributed frequency channels are retained. |
| Channel centre range | 800000000 to 1088000000 | Hz | Use the supplied frequency values verbatim. |
| Noise standard deviation | 0.1 | Jy/beam | Per real Stokes component; the complex variance is twice its square. |
| Speed of light | 299792458 | m/s | Exact vacuum constant. |
| Polarization sign | P = Q + i U | — | Forward exponent has positive 2 i phi t. |
| Wavelength reference | Weighted mean of squared wavelength | m² | Weights are inverse per component variance. |
| Channel approximation | Monochromatic at channel centre | — | No channel bandwidth integration. |
| Missing channels | None | — | No flags or implicit interpolation. |
| Spatial convention | One independent line of sight | — | Beam integrated spectral observation; no transverse image axes. |
| Depth boundary | Zero component flux outside declared output grid | rad/m² | Finite represented depth support; no periodic physical emission assumption. |

| Noise calibration | unavailable | digital count | No calibrated statistical noise model is supplied. |
| Exposure and frame interval | unavailable | second | Output is displacement, not velocity. |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains existing processed real thermography observations and their acquisition coordinates. All arrays use an explicit batch axis.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| temperature | (1, 25, 66, 50) | float64 | Absolute steel-panel temperatures in Kelvin, ordered time, vertical, horizontal, including a one-pixel spatial collar. |
| time | (1, 25) | float64 | Observation times from 100 to 124 seconds after ignition. |
| x | (1, 50) | float64 | Horizontal observation coordinates in metres, increasing with column index. |
| y | (1, 66) | float64 | Vertical observation coordinates in metres, increasing with row index. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Panel material | 304 stainless steel | 1 | Thin panel observed by infrared thermography. |
| Thickness d | 0.000793 | m | Selected panel thickness. |
| Emissivity and absorptivity epsilon | 0.94 | 1 | Equal grey-surface values on both faces. |
| Density rho | 8050 | kg/m³ | Selected nominal steel material law. |
| Conductivity k(T) | 8.1119 ln(T / 1 K) - 30.377 | W/(m K) | Nominal temperature-dependent material law; T is Kelvin. |
| Heat capacity cp(T) | 1000 [0.1414 ln(T / 1 K) - 0.3534] | J/(kg K) | Nominal temperature-dependent material law. |
| Ambient T(a) | 293.15 | K | Fixed room-temperature boundary assumption. |
| Exposed-face h(f) | 10 | W/(m² K) | Fixed constant-convection model assumption. |
| Back-face h(b) | 10 | W/(m² K) | Fixed constant-convection model assumption. |
| Stefan–Boltzmann constant sigma | 5.67 times 10^-8 | W/(m² K^4) | Rounded value used by the selected energy model. |
| Spatial sampling | 0.0127 in both directions | m | Half-inch square observation grid. |
| Temporal sampling | 1 | s | Uniform spacing of the supplied frames. |
| Target boundary information | Measured one-pixel spatial collar | 1 | Supplies all four neighbors of each target pixel. |
| Through-thickness approximation | Uniform temperature | 1 | Thin-skin energy balance; no thickness-resolved unknown. |
| Spatial coordinates | Increasing x and y; arrays ordered time,y,x | 1 | Coordinate arrays fix positions without image-axis ambiguity. |

The temperatures are already on an absolute Kelvin scale. Preserve their stored numerical precision; do not add 273.15. The chosen material and convection laws define the reference physical approximation and are not independently measured heat-flux truth. No other file is required to formulate the inverse problem.

data_source.description:
| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| measurements | (1, 256, 256, 256) | uint16 | Native spatial image photon counts; axes batch,y,x,delay; unit photons per delay bin accumulated over 40 frames |
| calibration | (1, 1, 1, 256) | uint64 | Independently measured fluorescein photon histogram pooled over its entire spatial image; unit photons per delay bin |
| valid_mask | (1, 256, 256) | uint8 | Fixed observation-validity support, 1 valid and 0 excluded; dimensionless |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Laser period | 24.99989318828099 | ns | Stored acquisition value; periodic temporal boundary |
| Fundamental frequency | 40.00017089948058 | MHz | Reciprocal period in matching units |
| Time bins | 256 | dimensionless | Uniform bins k=0,...,255 with t=k period/256 |
| Calibration lifetime | 4.1 | ns | Independently known fluorescein lifetime |
| Frames | 40 | dimensionless | Sample accumulation frames |
| Spatial grid | 256 by 256 | pixels | Original complete field of view, no resampling |
| Spatial coordinates | y then x, zero based | pixels | Original stored detector indexing; physical pixel pitch is unavailable and not needed for independent per-pixel inversion |
| Noise | Photon counting | photons | No background or Gaussian variance correction is supplied |
| Validity convention | count sum at least 200; G>0; S>0; G²+S²<1 | dimensionless | Fixed support derived solely from observations and independent calibration, before scoring |

Calibration photons are summed before normalization, equivalently giving intensity-weighted calibration phasor averaging. No dark count, time shift, median filter or implicit histogram offset is prescribed.

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains only observations and independent instrument/spectral calibration. All arrays are batch-first.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| intensity | (1, 68, 2, 4860) | float64 | Complete continuous-wave intensity recording, instrument arbitrary units; wavelength axis 760 then 850 nm. |
| distances | (1, 68) | float64 | Source–detector Euclidean separation in meters. |
| extinction | (1, 2, 2) | float64 | Natural-log absorption coefficients in m^-1 mM^-1; rows wavelength, columns HbO then HbR. |
| positions | (1, 68, 3) | float64 | Source–detector midpoint coordinates in meters, in the original head coordinate system; used to locate channels. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dataset | FRESH Motor Dataset, subject 01, session left2s | — | Complete native recording, not a temporal or spatial crop. |
| Sampling frequency | 8.928571428571429 | Hz | Uniform native sampling rate. |
| Samples | 4860 | — | Time coordinates are sample index divided by sampling frequency, starting at zero. |
| Last sample time | 544.208 | s | Time coordinate of the final sample. |
| Wavelength order | 760, 850 | nm | Rows of the spectral calibration and wavelength axis. |

### `data/raw_data.npz`

Low-resolution FPM intensity measurements under 68 LED illuminations (green channel).

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|

| `mag` | `()` | float32 | Microscope magnification factor (10x). Dimensionless. |
| `dpix_c` | `()` | float32 | Camera pixel pitch in micrometers (3.45 um). |

High-resolution amplitude z-stack from conventional FPM reconstruction, used as ground truth for evaluation.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|

| `zvec` | `(1, 161)` | float32 | Z-positions corresponding to each slice, linearly spaced from -20 to +20 um. |

Imaging parameters and training hyperparameters. Key fields include: wavelength (0.5126 um), objective NA (0.256), magnification (10x), pixel pitch (3.45 um), 68 LEDs, 512 spatial frequency modes, 2x upsampling, z-range [-20, +20] um with 161 evaluation slices.

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains all recorded radar samples and independently measured survey geometry:

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| radar | (1, 512, 1040) | float64 | Signed receiver amplitudes in instrument counts; axes batch, recorded time, profile trace. Original integer values are preserved exactly in float64. |
| time_ns | (1, 512) | float64 | Recorded time coordinates in ns, including the instrument delay. |
| position_m | (1, 1040) | float64 | Trace positions in m along the profile, with first trace at zero. |
| topo_position_m | (1, 36) | float64 | Along-profile positions in m of independently surveyed surface-elevation stations. |
| surface_elevation_m | (1, 36) | float64 | Surface elevation in m in the source survey's vertical datum, paired with topo_position_m. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recorded time window | 0.0 to 48.0 | ns | 512 sampled times, both endpoints included in the supplied coordinates. |
| Sampling interval | 0.09393346379647749 | ns | Preserved float64 interval of the supplied time axis. |
| Trace density | 50.0 | traces/m | GSSI acquisition-header spatial calibration. |
| Trace spacing | 0.02 | m | Uniform physical spacing derived from trace density. |
| Complete trace count | 1040 | traces | Entire measured line, with x from 0 to 20.78 m. |
| Instrument time delay t0 | 5.0 | ns | Fixed nominal arrival-time calibration used for continuous time-zero resampling. |
| Background wave velocity v | 140000000.0 | m/s | Selected homogeneous-background model, equivalent to 0.14 m/ns; not a measured permittivity map. |
| Output depth spacing | 0.006575342465753425 | m | Half the nominal velocity times the time interval in seconds. |
| Coordinates | x along profile, z downward | dimensionless | Nominal planar imaging coordinates; elevation is upward in the independent survey datum. |
| Offset model | Zero-offset approximation | dimensionless | Treat transmitter and receiver as coincident for this scalar migration. |
| Noise calibration | Unavailable | counts | No independent sample-wise variance or noise-free radargram is supplied. |
| Boundary model | Finite aperture, periodic Fourier transform | dimensionless | Linear edge weighting precedes migration; temporal spectral interpolation uses the stated endpoint-extension convention. |

Surface elevation is independent acquisition geometry, not an estimate from the unknown subsurface. A vertical display shift using it does not correct wave propagation for topography or lateral velocity variation.

data_source.description:
The observations are a spatial subset of the Stanford human HARDI acquisition, retaining all measured volumes. They are motion-corrected magnitude images, not raw k-space or newly simulated measurements. No spatial interpolation, intensity scaling, synthetic noise or angular subsampling is applied during packaging.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| signal | (1, 24, 24, 1, 160) | float64 | MRI magnitude measurements in arbitrary instrument units; last axis is acquisition volume. |
| bvalues | (1, 160) | float64 | Diffusion weighting in s/mm^2, aligned to signal volumes. |
| directions | (1, 160, 3) | float64 | Dimensionless diffusion-gradient direction components, x/y/z in the supplied image coordinate convention; zero for unweighted volumes. |

### Acquisition metadata

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sequence | Dual spin echo | dimensionless | Diffusion-weighted MRI acquisition |
| Weighted volumes | 150 | count | Single measured angular shell |
| Unweighted volumes | 10 | count | First ten acquisitions used to estimate S0 |
| Diffusion shell | 2000 | s/mm^2 | Nonzero diffusion weighting |
| b0 classification | 50 | s/mm^2 | Values at or below this cutoff are unweighted |
| Voxel spacing | 2, 2, 2 | mm | Image x, y, z spacing |
| Original crop | x=40:64, y=40:64, z=35:36 | voxel | Zero-based half-open indices in the deposited image |
| Gradient rounding | Maximum norm error 0.000007722 | dimensionless | Deposited text precision; compute angles from vector direction |
| Spatial boundary | Independent voxels | dimensionless | No spatial convolution or boundary extension |
| Motion correction | Rigid alignment to mean b0 | dimensionless | Depositor preprocessing |
| Eddy-current correction | Not applied by depositor | dimensionless | Dual-spin-echo acquisition |
| Noise variance | Not supplied | arbitrary units squared | No calibrated noise model is available |

data_source.description:
The data are real in-vivo observations from the **In Vivo Mouse Tumor** component of the public OPULM/PALA dataset, version 1.1, DOI [10.5281/zenodo.4343435](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4343435). The bound observations are complete IQ blocks 001 through 030 of a 150-block acquisition, each containing 200 frames. Their spatial dimensions and complex64 samples are preserved without cropping, denoising, synthetic noise, interpolation, or quantization changes. These are beamformed observations, rather than raw channel RF measurements. The bound subset spans the first 30 blocks; incomplete vascular sampling remains a scientific limitation.

`data/raw_data.npz` contains exactly one public array:

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| iq | (1, 30, 83, 128, 200) | complex64 | Measured complex IQ amplitude, arbitrary acquisition amplitude units; axes batch, block, axial position, lateral position, frame |

### Acquisition metadata

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frame rate within a block | 500 | Hz | Frame interval 0.002 s; do not use this to bridge block gaps |
| Frames per block | 200 | frames | Complete observed time series in each block |
| Block repetition frequency | 2 | Hz | Archived setting; no supplied absolute timestamps, and reported paper duration differs |
| Bound blocks | 001 through 030 | block identifiers | Original chronological file ordering |
| Native image size | 83 axial by 128 lateral | acquisition pixel | No bound spatial crop |
| Coordinate axes | axial down; lateral right | convention | Native pixel centers indexed from zero |
| Transmit frequency | 15 | MHz | Stored transmit/demodulation frequency |
| Receive frequency setting | 60 | MHz | Stored acquisition receive setting |
| Sampling frequency | 30 | MHz | Archived channel sampling rate; input has already been beamformed |
| Compounding steering angles | -10, -5, 0, 5, 10 | degree | Angles used for each compounded IQ image |
| Transmit cycles | 3 | cycles | Stored pulse length setting |
| Transducer element pitch | 0.11 | mm | Element spacing; do not equate it with the beamformed axial/lateral pixel size |
| Native spatial unit | 1 | acquisition pixel | Common coordinate unit used by the selected tracking/rendering convention |
| Absolute image pixel size | unavailable | mm/pixel | No independently verified conversion is supplied |
| Point response | not separately calibrated | acquisition amplitude unit | Local symmetric-response approximation, with no target-derived PSF supplied |
| Noise variance | unknown | amplitude unit squared | No calibrated independent Gaussian-noise variance is asserted |
| Image boundary | finite measured field of view | convention | No periodic spatial boundary or extrapolated frames |
| Output subdivision | 10 | superpixel per acquisition pixel | Fixed output scale; not a claim of independently measured anatomical resolution |

Reference computation promotes the unchanged public complex64 observations to complex128 before temporal subspace decomposition. A single-precision Gram decomposition is sensitive to numerical backend in this data; use adequate numerical precision for the tissue/bubble separation. Tracking interpolation results are quantized to float32 before rendering, preserving the stated output grid conventions.

Dataset records list CC BY 4.0, while accompanying materials identify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Treat the bound data and adapted processing as research materials under the more restrictive accompanying terms; attribution and the discrepancy are retained in maintainer provenance.

Both arrays are derived from full-resolution (3040×4056) PNG images captured
with a Raspberry Pi HQ Camera behind a piece of Scotch tape (the diffuser).
Downsampled by factor 4 for computational tractability.  Background
(dark-current) is subtracted before normalisation.

No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task; the task uses a real capture of a "thumbs-up" shown on a smartphone screen where no aligned ground-truth image was collected. `data/baseline_reference.npz` contains the ADMM reconstruction (300 iterations) used as the reference for NCC/NRMSE evaluation.

1. **u-update** (TV proximal): soft thresholding on the finite-difference
   image gradient `Ψv`.
2. **x-update** (data consistency): element-wise division in the padded spatial
   domain (the operator `CᵀC + μ₁I` is diagonal).
3. **w-update** (non-negativity): component-wise ReLU.
4. **v-update** (image synthesis): solved in the frequency domain because
   `MᵀM` and `ΨᵀΨ` are simultaneously diagonalised by the 2-D DFT.  The
   denominator `μ₁|H̃|² + μ₂|Ψ̃|² + μ₃` is precomputed once.

Preprocessing module for Lucky Imaging
=======================================

Load video frames, convert to monochrome, apply Gaussian blur,
compute brightness statistics, and prepare Laplacian images.

Functions
---------
load_frames           Load frames from raw_data.npz
to_mono               Convert RGB frame to monochrome
gaussian_blur         Apply Gaussian blur and upscale to 16-bit
average_brightness    Compute mean brightness within valid range
compute_laplacian     Compute Laplacian of blurred frame at stride
prepare_all_frames    Prepare all frames for the pipeline

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` stores the measured Fourier observations and legitimate independent calibration. No spatial voxel or acquisition cycle was removed. Frequency selection was fixed from independent calibration SNR and the source acquisition's80kHz high-pass convention; no target geometry or target-derived calibration is provided.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| calibration | (1,7116,6859) | complex64 | Native independent delta-sample Fourier responses in instrument a.u.; axes batch, selected frequency/channel row, voxel with x fastest. |
| calibration_background | (1,7116,362) | complex64 | Native independent empty-bore calibration responses in instrument a.u.; all362 background frames. |
| foreground | (1,1000,7116) | complex128 | Unscaled Fourier amplitudes of all1000 specimen cycles in instrument a.u.; axes batch, cycle, selected row. |
| background | (1,1000,7116) | complex128 | Unscaled Fourier amplitudes of all1000 empty-bore observation cycles in instrument a.u.; same row order. |
| frequency | (1,7116) | float64 | Frequency of each selected Fourier row in Hz; repeated across receive channels. |
| channel | (1,7116) | uint8 | Zero-based receive-channel index0,1,2, dimensionless; ordered channel first then ascending frequency. |
| calibration_snr | (1,7116) | float64 | Author-supplied independent calibration SNR for each retained row, dimensionless. |
| voxel_positions | (1,6859,3) | float64 | Voxel-center coordinates in meters, columns x,y,z; x-fastest ordering matching calibration. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | Bruker/Philips preclinical FFP scanner | dimensionless identifier | Actual2018 author measurements, not simulated data. |
| Tracer | Perimag, iron solute | dimensionless identifier | Same tracer in independent delta calibration and specimen. |
| Selection-field gradient | diagonal(-1,-1,2) | T/m | Three-axis static encoding gradient. |
| Drive-field amplitude | (12,12,12) | mT | Three sinusoidal excitation components. |
| Drive-field frequency | 2.5MHz divided by(102,96,99) | Hz | x,y,z drive frequencies; all phases pi/2 radians. |
| Acquisition cycle | 0.0215424 | seconds | One complete3-D Lissajous cycle. |
| Native samples per cycle | 53856 | samples/channel | Entire native time record transformed without temporal padding. |
| Receiver sample rate | 2500000 | Hz | Twice the1.25MHz receiver bandwidth. |
| Receiver channels | 3 | channels | All receive directions retained subject to calibration-only frequency selection. |
| Fourier frequency | k/(0.0215424), k=0,...,26928 | Hz | Unscaled real FFT of native cycles; stored rows identify k through frequency. |
| Selected rows | frequency>80000 and native calibration SNR>2; Nyquist omitted | Hz / dimensionless | All qualifying rows from all3 channels,7116 total; no target-dependent mask. |
| Calibration spatial grid | (19,19,19) | voxels | Full native grid, including overscan outside the driven field. |
| Calibration field of view | (38,38,19) | mm | Native MDF calibration extent, not the smaller drive-field excursion. |
| Drive-field extent | (24,24,12) | mm | Derived from drive amplitudes and selection gradient. |
| Grid center | (0,0,0) | mm | Voxel centers x/y=-18,-16,...,18mm; z=-9,-8,...,9mm. |
| Delta sample | (2,2,1)mm,4 microliters,0.1mol(Fe)/L | mm / microliters / mol/L | Independent calibration amount0.4micromol Fe. |
| Stored calibration averaging | 100 | native averages/frame | As recorded by MDF; stored Fourier amplitudes already represent that acquisition averaging. |
| Specimen / empty-bore cycles | 1000 /1000 | cycles | All cycles supplied; benchmark reconstructs their static averaged distribution. |
| Calibration backgrounds | 362 | frames | Separate empty-bore frames acquired throughout calibration. |
| Receive transfer correction | not supplied/applied | dimensionless | Calibration and specimen share the same receive-chain convention. |
| Spatial boundary | full finite calibration grid | mm | No extrapolation, periodic spatial wrapping or implicit voxel crop. |

`data/raw_data.npz` contains measured observations only:

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| displacement | (1, 2, 48, 49) | float64 | Measured ux,uy in original fluorescent-image pixels; multiply by 0.201 µm/pixel. Axes batch, component (x,y), increasing physical y, increasing physical x. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fluorescent-image pixel size | 0.201 | µm/pixel | Metric calibration of measured displacement amplitudes. |
| Displacement sample pitch | 8.040000000000001 | µm | Stored float64 value of 40 × 0.201; equal x/y spacing. |
| PIV interrogation width | 100 | image pixels | Gaussian subpixel cross-correlation of bead image pairs. |
| PIV overlap | 60 | image pixels | Adjacent measurement centres differ by 40 image pixels. |
| Original bead-image size | 1989 × 2034 | image pixels | Entire experimental image pair underlying the observed field. |
| Displacement array size | 48 × 49 | grid samples | Entire PIV measurement field, without selecting a favourable region. |
| Young's modulus E | 49000.0 | Pa | Polyacrylamide substrate elasticity. |
| Poisson ratio ν | 0.49 | dimensionless | Nearly incompressible substrate. |
| Layer thickness h | 300.0 | µm | Bonded elastic substrate thickness. |
| Coordinates | x right; y upward | dimensionless | Displacement field rows increase physically upward; original image rows were reversed without changing signed component values. |
| Origin | Lower-left displacement sample | dimensionless | Translation-invariant elastic model; absolute image origin is not required. |
| Noise | No calibrated pointwise variance | image pixels | PIV peak-ratio validation and local-mean outlier replacement precede the supplied observation. |
| Boundary convention | Zero-padded even square; periodic FFT | dimensionless | Place data at the final rows/columns of a 50×50 grid, then crop to the same support. |

The physical y convention and exact PIV sampling step are stated explicitly. This calibrated application of the published elastic method does not claim an unchanged pixelwise reproduction of a tutorial that uses approximate image-size-based sampling.

Generate and prepare the microscope_denoising benchmark dataset.

Downloads the 2D fluorescence microscopy example data from Zenodo
(DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7261163) and packages it into the standard npz format.

Dataset: TIRF fluorescence images of Microtubules acquired at low-SNR
conditions on a Multi-SIM system (Qiao et al., Nat. Commun. 2024).

Output layout:
  data/raw_data.npz      - key "measurements": shape (55, 502, 502), float32
                            55 noisy TIRF Microtubule images, background ~100 ADU,
                            average signal ~10 ADU above background.
  data/ground_truth.npz  - key "psf": shape (1, 32, 32), float32
                            Center-cropped, normalised PSF kernel used for
                            Stage 2 (deconvolution) training and evaluation.
  data/meta_data.json    - imaging parameters and noise model estimates.
data_source.description:
### `data/raw_data.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `measurements` | (55, 502, 502) | float32 | 55 noisy TIRF Microtubule images. Camera background ~100 ADU; mean signal above background ~10 ADU (very low SNR). Each frame is an independent low-SNR acquisition. |
| `psf` | (1, 32, 32) | float32 | Center-cropped, unit-sum PSF kernel for the Microtubule channel (525 nm emission, NA 1.3, pixel size 0.0313 µm). Used in Stage 2 deconvolution training and PSF-residual evaluation. |

### `data/baseline_reference.npz`

No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task; since all 55 frames are from different cells (no pixel-level reference exists), `data/baseline_reference.npz` contains the ZS-DeconvNet outputs from the reference run (30 000 iterations), used for NCC/NRMSE evaluation.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `denoised` | (1, 502, 502) | float32 | Stage 1 denoised output for frame 01 |
| `deconvolved` | (1, 502, 502) | float32 | Stage 2 deconvolved output for frame 01 |

### `data/meta_data.json`

| Field | Value | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `modality` | `"TIRF fluorescence microscopy"` | Total internal reflection fluorescence |
| `structure` | `"Microtubule (filamentous)"` | Cytoskeletal filaments ~25 nm diameter |
| `pixel_size_um` | 0.0313 | Lateral pixel size in micrometres |
| `emission_wavelength_nm` | 525 | Fluorescence emission wavelength |
| `na` | 1.3 | Numerical aperture |
| `background_adu` | 100 | Camera bias offset $b$ |
| `noise_model.beta1_estimated` | ~0.75 | Poissonian factor (estimated from data) |
| `noise_model.beta2_estimated` | ~3.7 | Read noise variance (estimated from data) |
| `noise_model.alpha_recorruption` | 1.5 | Recorruption noise strength $\alpha$ |
| `psf.kernel_size` | 32 | PSF kernel size in pixels |

references:
Synthetic Dynamic DCE-MRI Data Generation
==========================================

Creates a time-varying 128x128 phantom with contrast agent uptake,
generates per-frame variable-density Cartesian undersampled k-space,
and adds complex Gaussian noise.

Phantom design:
    - Static background: elliptical body + inner structures (Shepp-Logan-like)
    - Dynamic component: two small enhancing regions that follow a
      gamma-variate contrast uptake curve with different timing parameters

The gamma-variate model for concentration is:
    C(t) = A * ((t - t_arrival) / t_peak)^alpha * exp(-alpha * (t - t_arrival) / t_peak)
    for t > t_arrival, else 0.

data_source.description:
The bound observation is the complete `scene026/blur/blur_3.png` camera exposure from the RealBlur-J dataset, converted to the integer luminance channel of the full-range YCrCb convention, then divided by 255. It has not been resized, cropped, synthetically blurred or corrupted with additional noise. RealBlur-J is processed JPEG-domain data distributed in PNG containers. Dataset registration and intensity processing predate this task; this is not raw sensor radiance.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `observation` | `(1, 753, 668)` | `float32` | Real processed exposure luminance, dimensionless relative full scale; axes batch, row, column |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Source modality | Sony A7R3 real camera exposure | none | Measured handheld motion blur, not a numerical blur simulation |
| Spatial sampling | 753 rows by 668 columns | pixel | Complete distributed image raster; row increases downward and column rightward |
| Photometric convention | Integer full-range YCrCb luminance divided by 255 | relative full scale | Quantized processed intensity; no linear-radiance claim |
| Luminance conversion | `(4899 R + 9617 G + 1868 B + 8192) >> 14` | integer DN | RGB channels have 8-bit range; divide the integer result by 255 |
| Quantization step | `1/255` | relative full scale | Precision of the distributed luminance observation |
| Assumed kernel support | 51 by 51 | pixel | Specified finite-support blind forward-model assumption, not a measured calibration |
| Latent model extent | 803 rows by 718 columns | pixel | Adds a 25-pixel latent boundary on each side to model the complete measurement |
| Forward boundary convention | Valid cross-correlation | none | No circular convolution; no observed boundary padding |
| Kernel origin convention | Index `(25,25)` corresponds to the reported image origin | pixel | Translation remains ambiguous within the specified gauge |
| Exposure trajectory and noise variance | Unknown | none | Must not be assumed calibrated; structured residuals may remain |
| Pixel pitch and exposure time | Not supplied with this sample | none | Neither is needed for the pixel-domain model; no metric displacement or radiometric inference is requested |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains all 408 measured points, in their original precision and ordering.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| q | (1, 408) | float64 | Momentum transfer Q, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, observation). |
| reflectivity | (1, 408) | float64 | Measured specular intensity ratio, dimensionless; axes (batch, observation). |
| standard_error | (1, 408) | float64 | One standard deviation reflectivity uncertainty, dimensionless; axes (batch, observation). |
| q_fwhm | (1, 408) | float64 | Point dependent Gaussian Q resolution FWHM, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, observation). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | PLATYPUS | — | Neutron reflectometer; supplied curve is already reduced to specular reflectivity. |
| Fronting SLD | 2.07 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Semi-infinite silicon incident medium. |
| Oxide SLD | 3.47 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Fixed uniform native oxide layer SLD. |
| Backing SLD | 6.36 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Semi-infinite heavy water exit medium. |

| Confidence exclusion | square half-width 2 | correlation pixel | Exclude the 5 by 5 neighborhood centered on the first peak when finding the second. |
| Peak stability offset | 0.0000001 | normalized correlation | Added to each correlation map after finding an interior peak, before subpixel fitting and confidence measurement. |

These conventions define the requested auxiliary quantity, not a calibrated probability of correctness.

references: This is a new material-science observation-to-spatial-field task: measured reference/sample grid images are inverted into transmission and three directional second-moment maps. It is not scalar calibration or chemical concentration fitting. No existing task was modified. The supplied observations already existed; no new synthetic benchmark data were generated. The analytic Gaussian blur in tests is a mathematical unit check only.

Paper: Michelle K. Croughan, Ying Ying How, Allan Pennings, Kaye S. Morgan, Directional dark-field retrieval with single-grid x-ray imaging, Optics Express 31(7), 11578-11597, published version 2023, DOI https://doi.org/10.1364/OE.480031 . Author reference repository: https://github.com/Xray-grill/DiDaFi_MKCroughan , remotely verified revision ef998eaf39021a98fae2bb8ff0bddfdd1493a4e7 (archived didafi_commit.json). Its BSD-3-Clause license is preserved verbatim as task LICENSE. Original source copyright is retained. The author repository supplies the measured PMMA dataset under Diffusive_DF_data/Grid/PMMA with the repository-wide BSD license and no file-specific contrary license; its README explicitly identifies supplied example and associated dark-field data. This is an existing author-distributed real measurement dataset, not newly generated observations or a paper figure digitization. The associated diffusive dark-field acquisition is distinguished from claiming that every ROI is the directional paper's printed figure.

Data URLs at the fixed revision are https://github.com/Xray-grill/DiDaFi_MKCroughan/tree/ef998eaf39021a98fae2bb8ff0bddfdd1493a4e7/Diffusive_DF_data/Grid/PMMA . Original files are Flats_00.tif, GridA_00.tif, GridA+Sample_00.tif, float32 2136 by 2544. Fixed rows 900:1368 and columns 1000:1468 were selected before the oracle. Public counts and flat retain float32 exactly and gain a batch axis only. The period 12.68550106609808 was obtained using the original Fourier calibration on the full grid-only observation; no sample or hidden field enters this legitimate reference calibration. Dark=0 and unity exposure normalization are assumptions, not measured camera calibrations. Missing detector pitch and propagation distance prevent converting the moments into angular variance; units remain detector-pixel squared.

data_source.description:
The input is `data/raw_data.npz`; all arrays include batch size one.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angular_frequency` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Native angular frequency in rad/s. |
| `storage_modulus` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Measured storage modulus G prime in Pa. |
| `loss_modulus` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Measured loss modulus G double-prime in Pa. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frequency convention | Angular frequency | rad/s | Do not multiply the supplied coordinate by 2π |
| Measurement channels | Storage modulus G prime and loss modulus G double-prime | Pa | Positive linear-viscoelastic response |
| Native observations | 100 frequency pairs | 1 | Entire author-curated Watanabe binary linear-blend example |
| Fluid plateau | 0 | Pa | Selected dataset/model has no equilibrium elastic term |
| Continuous output grid | tau_min*ratio^j, j=0..99 | s | tau_min=exp(-π/2)/omega_max; tau_max=exp(π/2)/omega_min; ratio=(tau_max/tau_min)^(1/99) |
| Continuous quadrature | Trapezoidal in ln(tau) | 1 | Spectrum density integrates with logarithmic measure |
| Fitted output frequency grid | 100 geometric points from min to max native angular frequency | rad/s | Linear interpolation of measured moduli at those points |
| Discrete representation | 13 modes, sorted by increasing relaxation time | 1 | Fixed output capacity for this bound selected model |
| Noise covariance | Not supplied | Pa² | Relative-residual formulation handles large modulus range |

data_source.description:
The first acquired time point at every deposited stage position is retained, with all native defocus planes and the complete detector region. Empty-field images and the instrument-response settings were calibrated independently of the specimen.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| intensities | (1, 3, 4, 16, 128, 256) | uint16 | Raw analyzer intensities in ADU; axes batch, position, analyzer state, defocus, row, column |
| background | (1, 4, 128, 256) | float64 | Independent no-sample analyzer images, ADU; axes batch, analyzer state, row, column |
| instrument_matrix | (1, 4, 4) | float64 | Analyzer response A, dimensionless; rows State0 through State3, columns Stokes s0 through s3 |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wavelength | 532 | nm | Incident light wavelength |
| Analyzer scheme | 4-State | dimensionless | State0, State1, State2, State3 order |
| Liquid-crystal swing | 0.1 | wave | Calibration retardance swing |
| Dark offset | 100.58 | ADU | Measured camera black level, subtract from specimen and background |
| Extinction ratio | 164.47 | dimensionless | Independently measured polarimeter extinction |
| Exposure | 10.0 | ms | Specimen page metadata; background exposure not deposited |
| Objective | 20x, NA 0.55, dry | dimensionless | Actual microscope page hardware metadata |
| Defocus spacing | 2.0 | micrometer | Native z step, planes 0 through 15 |
| First recorded z | 197.5 | micrometer | Stage-z coordinate in specimen page metadata |
| Detector region | 128 by 256 | pixel | Complete native recorded region |
| Lateral object-plane pitch | Not reliably deposited | unavailable | Page PixelSizeUm is zero; use detector pixels rather than inventing micrometer distances |
| Stage positions | 0, 1, 2 | index | Original deposited position order |
| Included time point | 0 | zero-based index | First complete acquired time point |
| Coordinates | x increases right, y increases down | detector pixel | No orientation rotation or flip |
| Spatial boundary | Per-pixel retarder model | dimensionless | No spatial convolution or wraparound |
| Saturation | Zero samples at 65535 | sample | No detector clipping in the bound acquisition |
| Noise variance | Not calibrated | unavailable | Preserve noisy P estimates, including values above one |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` preserves all50native author images after the original arithmetic mean of their three RGB channels. It contains no newly generated observations.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| measurements | (1, 50, 256, 256) | float64 | Grayscale relative image intensity, dimensionless author units; axes batch,light,row,column. |
| light_directions | (1, 50, 3) | float64 | Calibrated distant-light direction/intensity vectors, dimensionless, Cartesian x,y,z. |
| support | (1, 256, 256) | bool | Observed foreground silhouette, dimensionless; True marks requested unit normals. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Image size | 256 by256 | pixel | Full native observation grid; no spatial crop or resizing. |
| Illumination count | 50 | 1 | All rows of the supplied illumination array, in measurement order. |
| Viewpoint | Fixed orthographic | 1 | The surface remains in the same image coordinates under all lights. |
| RGB conversion | Arithmetic mean of three original channels | 1 | Linear grayscale intensity convention already applied. |
| Exposure scale | Author-relative, unchanged | 1 | Do not normalize each frame independently. |
| Light convention | Diffuse dot product with supplied Cartesian vectors | 1 | Retain vector magnitudes and signs; no coordinate reorientation. |
| Surface support | Supplied observed silhouette | 1 | Foreground is reconstructed; background must be zero. |
| Non-diffuse effects | Existing specularities and shadows | relative intensity | Unknown additive departures from the diffuse model. |
| Calibrated stochastic noise | Not supplied | 1 | No known Gaussian variance or photon count is asserted. |
| Pixel pitch | Not specified | 1 | Recover orientation on the native index grid, not metric depth. |
| Spatial boundary | Pixelwise inverse | 1 | No external spatial boundary values are required. |

data_source.description:
All arrays stored in `.npz` files follow the batch-first convention `(1, ...)`.

### `data/raw_data.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `v_mig` | `(1, 600, 250)` | float32 | Smooth migration velocity model used by the direct-arrival and Born propagators (m/s) |
| `observed_data` | `(1, 20, 100, 300)` | float32 | Observed pressure shot gathers for 20 shots, 100 receivers per shot, and 300 time samples (pressure amplitude units) |

### `data/ground_truth.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `v_true` | `(1, 600, 250)` | float32 | True Marmousi P-wave velocity model used to synthesize the observations (m/s) |

### `data/meta_data.json`
`meta_data.json` stores imaging parameters only: full-model and cropped-model sizes, spatial grid spacing, acquisition geometry, source wavelet settings, and time sampling. It intentionally excludes solver hyperparameters such as optimizer type, iteration count, and loss scaling.
