references: The public archive contains the complete original processed Sentinel-1 observation stack, without synthetic additions, spatial subsampling or a reduction in acquisition dates. The original unwrapped phase band is retained in float32, and all spatial axes preserve the source raster order. ERA5 delay is an independently computed weather-model product supplied with the original dataset; it is a legitimate external correction input, not a target-derived calibration.

The baseline sensitivity uses the complete-scene mean slant range and mean sine of incidence, rather than an unannounced pixelwise geometry replacement. The distributed observations were already multilooked, filtered and spatially unwrapped by their data provider; reconstructing SAR focusing or generating new interferograms is outside this inverse problem.

data_source.description:
The public archive contains the complete original processed Sentinel-1 observation stack, without synthetic additions, spatial subsampling or a reduction in acquisition dates. The original unwrapped phase band is retained in float32, and all spatial axes preserve the source raster order. ERA5 delay is an independently computed weather-model product supplied with the original dataset; it is a legitimate external correction input, not a target-derived calibration.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original unwrapped phase, rad; batch, edge, azimuth, range |
| `coherence` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | float32 | Spatial interferometric coherence, dimensionless; same axes |
| `components` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | uint8 | Original connected-component labels, dimensionless; zero means unavailable |
| `dates` | `(1, 98)` | int32 | Ordered acquisition dates as YYYYMMDD, calendar dates without a physical unit |
| `pairs` | `(1, 288, 2)` | int16 | Zero-based first/second indices into `dates`, dimensionless |
| `baseline` | `(1, 98)` | float32 | Perpendicular baseline relative to the first acquisition, m; mean of the two supplied swath baseline values |
| `atmospheric_delay` | `(1, 98, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original ERA5-derived LOS displacement contribution, m; subtract after spatial/temporal re-referencing |
| `incidence` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original incidence angle, degrees; azimuth, range |
| `latitude` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float64 | Original pixel latitude, degrees north |
| `longitude` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float64 | Original pixel longitude, degrees east |
| `analysis_mask` | `(1, 450, 600)` | bool | All-edge observation-availability mask, dimensionless; 159,762 valid pixels |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sensor / orbit | Sentinel-1 A/B, descending track 128, VV | dimensionless | Radar platform, viewing track and polarization |
| Acquisition interval | 20141213 to 20180619 | calendar date | All 98 dates retained |
| Interferogram count | 288 | dimensionless | All original temporal edges retained |
| Frame shape | 450 by 600 | pixel | Complete original distributed scene |
| Wavelength | 0.05546576 | m | Phase-to-LOS conversion wavelength |
| Azimuth pixel spacing | 78.08212603857966 | m | Original multilooked sampling |
| Range pixel spacing | 34.94343172072985 | m | Original multilooked slant-range sampling |
| Starting slant range | 799547.2189154713 | m | Column zero range; column $x$ has this value plus $x$ times range spacing |
| Azimuth / range looks | 5 / 15 | dimensionless | Original acquisition processing |
| Heading | -168.01821899414062 | degree | Original satellite heading |
| Reference pixel | row 76, column 156 | zero-based pixel | Original reference point; latitude about -0.30, longitude about -91.43 degrees |
| Original raster subset origin | row 1150, column 1070 | source raster pixel | Original dataset preparation; no further crop is applied here |
| Spatial axes | increasing source azimuth row, increasing slant-range column | dimensionless | Use supplied geolocation for geographic interpretation |
| Temporal gauge | first acquisition | calendar date | Both requested displacement histories start at zero |
| Input ERA5 product reference date | 20180619 | calendar date | Product must be re-referenced to the first acquisition and the reference pixel |
| Eruption dates | 20170910, 20180613 | calendar date | Strict post-event temporal indicators |
| Component availability | zero label means missing; positive labels identify coherent regions | dimensionless | Preserve spatial region boundaries and actual temporal edge availability |
| Spatial connectivity / boundaries | four neighbours; native finite frame, no periodic extension | dimensionless | Connected-region convention |
| Noise information | measured spatial coherence; no calibrated independent phase variance supplied | dimensionless | Reliability varies across pixels and edges |

The baseline sensitivity uses the complete-scene mean slant range and mean sine of incidence, rather than an unannounced pixelwise geometry replacement. The distributed observations were already multilooked, filtered and spatially unwrapped by their data provider; reconstructing SAR focusing or generating new interferograms is outside this inverse problem.

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sample | polystyrene spheres in 53% H2O, 47% D2O | — | Real sample identified in the published data header; nominal diameter is approximate, not truth. |
| Measurement date | 2014-07-10 | calendar date | Date in original acquisition file. |
| Sample thickness t | 0.2 | cm | Physical path length used by the published reduced depolarisation. |
| Particle SLD | 1.41 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Known polystyrene scattering length density. |
| Solvent SLD | 2.70 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Known mixture scattering length density. |
| Encoding direction | Z | — | Laboratory gradient axis from original instrument file, not the radial reconstruction coordinate r. |
| Maximum vertical acceptance | 0.0168 | radian | Nominal acceptance angle in the encoding direction. |
| Maximum horizontal acceptance | 0.0168 | radian | Nominal orthogonal acceptance angle. |
| Scan type | sine, one element scan | — | Instrument acquisition mode. |
| D1 and D2 apertures | 20 by 8 | mm | Slit dimensions in the acquisition header. |
| Sample aperture | 16 by 10 | mm | Sample illumination dimensions. |
| Wavelength treatment | nominal stored values | Angstrom | No extra spectral convolution in the selected reduced sphere model. |
| Length uncertainty treatment | nominal coordinate fit | Angstrom | Reported errors retained; the selected standard model does not convolve over them. |
| Radial symmetry | isotropic, homogeneous spheres | — | Sphere overlap correlation model, no spatial particle localization. |
| Correlation boundary | zero beyond one particle diameter | — | Model support of the single-sphere overlap term. |

data_source.description:
### data/raw_data.npz

| Key               | Shape                      | Dtype   | Description |
|-------------------|----------------------------|---------|-------------|
| response_matrix   | (1, N_slopes, 150)         | float32 | Push-pull calibrated DM→slope response matrix [slope/m] |
| wfs_images        | (1, 4, 128, 128)           | float32 | Raw SH-WFS detector images at each WFE level [photons] |
| ref_image         | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Reference (flat wavefront) SH-WFS image [photons] |
| detector_coords_x | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Focal-plane x coordinate per pixel [m] |
| detector_coords_y | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Focal-plane y coordinate per pixel [m] |
| subap_map         | (1, 128, 128)              | int32   | Subaperture rank per pixel (−1 = invalid, 0..N_valid−1) |
| dm_modes          | (1, 150, N_pupil_px)       | float32 | DM mode shapes on the 128×128 pupil grid (disk harmonics, ptp-normalised) |
| aperture          | (1, N_pupil_px)            | float32 | Pupil transmission mask (128×128 px) |

N_slopes = 592 (296 valid subapertures × 2).
N_pupil_px = 16384 (128×128 pupil grid).
The 4 WFE levels (from `meta_data.json`) are 50, 100, 200, 400 nm RMS.

### data/ground_truth.npz

| Key              | Shape             | Dtype   | Description |
|------------------|-------------------|---------|-------------|
| wavefront_phases | (1, 4, N_pupil_px) | float32 | True wavefront phase at each WFE level [rad at λ_WFS = 700 nm] |

The ground-truth phase is a random DM mode combination scaled to the target RMS.
Because the ground truth lies in the DM mode subspace, perfect reconstruction is
in principle achievable in the noise-free limit.

### data/baseline_reference.npz

Reference PSF images produced by the HCIPy simulation, provided for qualitative
comparison of AO-corrected optical quality. Not used for NCC/NRMSE evaluation
(superseded by `ground_truth.npz`). All images are on a 240×240 focal-plane grid
(57 600 pixels), stored in row-major order.

|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `long_exposure_psf` | `(1, 57600)` | float32 | Long-exposure PSF with AO correction, averaged over 150-mode DM correction; peak-normalised [dimensionless] |
| `long_exposure_no_ao` | `(1, 57600)` | float32 | Long-exposure PSF without AO correction (turbulence only); peak-normalised [dimensionless] |
| `unaberrated_psf` | `(1, 57600)` | float32 | Diffraction-limited PSF (no aberrations, no turbulence); peak-normalised [dimensionless] |

Preprocessed NGC 1300 galaxy data used as source input for the simulation pipeline.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |

| `image_reconstructed` | `(1, 264, 264)` | `float32` | Galaxy image reconstructed from shapelet coefficients in counts |

### data/ground_truth.npz

Ground truth source image and lens model parameters (known from simulation).

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `source_image` | `(1, 320, 320)` | `float32` | Intrinsic (unlensed) high-resolution source image at 0.01 arcsec/pixel in counts |
| `theta_E` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Einstein radius of the SIS lens model in arcsec |
| `gamma` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Power-law slope of the SPEP lens model (2.0 = SIS) |
| `source_x` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Source center x-offset in arcsec |
| `source_y` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Source center y-offset in arcsec |

Imaging and instrument parameters for the forward model. Contains: detector geometry (`numPix=64`, `deltaPix=0.05` arcsec/pixel), PSF specification (`fwhm_lensing=0.1` arcsec, `fwhm_deconv=0.25` arcsec), noise parameters (`background_rms=10` counts, `exp_time=100` s), supersampling factor (`high_res_factor=5`), and lens parameters ($\theta_E=0.5$ arcsec, $\gamma=2.0$, zero ellipticity and shear).

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` — 2D localisations from a fixed BCR (B-cell receptor) B cell, imaged on a hexagonal FLFM. Localised using ImageJ GDSC SMLM2 PeakFit plugin.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `localizations_2d` | (150996, 35) | float32 | Raw PeakFit localisation array bundled with the task |

The bundled NPZ stores the original PeakFit-style columns. During loading,
`src.preprocessing.load_localizations` converts the required subset into the
standardised internal `(N, 8)` array used by the pipeline:
- raw **0** → frame index
- raw **9** → X position (pixels, converted to μm via `pixel_size_sample`)
- raw **10** → Y position (pixels, converted to μm via `pixel_size_sample`)
- raw **12** → sigma_X / sigma_Y (pixels, converted to μm)
- raw **8** → intensity (photons)
- raw **7** → background (photons)
- raw **13** → precision (nm, converted to μm)

Internal standardised layout after loading:
- **0** frame index
- **1** X position (μm)
- **2** Y position (μm)
- **3** sigma_X (μm)
- **4** sigma_Y (μm)
- **5** intensity (photons)
- **6** background (photons)
- **7** precision (μm)

> **Note**: No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task — the data comes from
> real experimental recordings with no simulation ground truth.

- **150,996 localisations** in **5,000 frames**
- Hexagonal MLA: 7 views in the back focal plane
- 60× water-immersion objective, NA 1.27

Source: `hexSMLFM` repository (TheLeeLab, University of Cambridge).

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |

data_source.description:
| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| count_rates | (1, 48, 48, 6) | float64 | Real exposure-normalized rates in DN/s/pixel, channels 94,131,171,193,211,335 angstrom. |
| uncertainty | (1, 48, 48, 6) | float64 | Adopted per-channel discrepancy standard deviations in DN/s/pixel. |
| response | (1, 101, 6) | float64 | Independent AIA nominal thermal responses in DN cm^5/s/pixel, same channel order. |
| response_log_temperature | (1, 101) | float32 (big-endian) | Log10(T/K) calibration grid, dimensionless logarithmic coordinates. |
| temperature_edges | (1, 21) | float64 | Required increasing temperature-bin boundaries in K. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Instrument and level | SDO/AIA synoptic level1.5 | dimensionless | Reused real full-disk observations, supplied registered sampling. |
| Wavelength order | 94,131,171,193,211,335 | angstrom | Common last-axis ordering. |
| UTC start times by channel | 2014-01-01T00:00:01.12,00:00:08.62,00:00:11.34,00:00:06.84;2013-12-31T23:59:59.62;2014-01-01T00:00:02.62 | UTC | Six near-simultaneous images; no temporal interpolation. |
| Exposure times | 2.900816,2.901307,1.999597,2.000014,2.900819,2.900797 | s | Stored FITS EXPTIME used verbatim before packaging rates. |
| Angular sampling | 2.4 by 2.4 | arcsec/pixel | Solar north increases with row; solar west with column. |
| Original reference pixel | (512.5,512.5) | FITS pixel | One-based helioprojective origin; zero-based x has longitude (x+1-512.5)*2.4 arcsec, analogous y. |
| ROI | rows415:463, columns424:472 | zero-based pixel | 48 by48 registered subimage; upper bounds excluded. |
| Temperature grid | log10(T/K)=5.6 to7.4;20equal log bins | dimensionless | Fixed requested temperature support. |
| Discrepancy uncertainty | 0.1*count_rate+1 | DN/s/pixel | Author-example convention, includes a10% modeling term and1DN/s floor; not a complete detector-noise likelihood. |
| Response calibration | nominal bundled AIA evenorm | DN cm^5/s/pixel | Independent instrument/plasma response; no target-derived calibration or additional time-dependent degradation correction. |
| Line of sight and boundaries | optically thin, independent spatial pixels | dimensionless | No spatial convolution or boundary extrapolation in this inverse. |

data_source.description:
The observation is the complete native equal-area GONG synoptic magnetic map for Carrington rotation 2234. No pixel downsampling or field crop is applied.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| magnetogram | (1, 180, 360) | float32 (big-endian FITS precision preserved) | Measured photospheric radial magnetic field in G; axes batch, sine latitude increasing south-to-north, Carrington longitude increasing from the stated edge. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | NSO-GONG network | identifier | Magnetic synoptic image product |
| Map observation time | 2020-09-01T13:04:00 | UTC | Last contributor epoch; map is assembled over time |
| Carrington rotation | 2234 | dimensionless | Rotation identifier |
| Diagnostic wavelength | 676.8 | nm | Photospheric spectral line |
| Number of contributing files | 7391 | count | Original image metadata |
| Projection | Cylindrical equal area | dimensionless | Uniform longitude and sine-latitude sampling |
| Longitude edge | 22.0 | degree | Western edge; centers offset by half a degree |
| Longitude spacing | 1.00000 | degree | Original stored increment |
| Sine-latitude increment in original header | 0.0111111 | dimensionless | Original decimal metadata, retained verbatim |
| Exact full-sphere grid increment | 2/180 | dimensionless | Full-sphere finite-volume coordinate definition |
| First axis center reference pixel | 180.500 | pixel | One-based original WCS convention |
| Second axis center reference pixel | 90.5000 | pixel | One-based equatorial reference |
| Central reference longitude | 202 | degree | Original WCS reference value |
| Inner shell radius | 1 | solar radius | Photospheric boundary |
| Outer shell radius | 2.5 | solar radius | Radial-field source-surface assumption |
| Grid and boundary conditions | 35 log-radius cells; periodic longitude; regular poles | dimensionless | Required finite-volume output geometry |
| Noise model | Not supplied | G | Instrument noise and synoptic evolution are not an independent known Gaussian variance |

### `data/raw_data.npz`

Single-disperser CASSI measurement using a KAIST color-checker crop as the scene, with a binary random coded aperture mask.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |

| `measurement` | (1, 256, 286) | float32 | Compressed 2D CASSI detector measurement (arbitrary units) |

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `hyperspectral_cube` | (1, 256, 256, 31) | float32 | Ground truth spectral data cube (normalised intensity, range ≈ [0, 1]) |

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `r` | 256 | Image height (pixels) |
| `c` | 256 | Image width (pixels) |
| `nC` | 31 | Number of spectral channels |

### `data/raw_data.npz`

Simulated intensity measurements for all illumination angles.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `measurements` | `(1, 8, 256, 256)` | float64 | Intensity images — batch × n_angles × Ny × Nx |

### meta_data

imaging parameters:

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `volume_shape` | [308, 256, 256] | Nz x Ny x Nx voxels |
| `res_um` | [0.1, 0.1, 0.1] | Voxel size in micrometers (dz, dy, dx) |
| `wavelength_um` | 0.5 | Illumination wavelength in μm |
| `n0` | 1.0 | Background refractive index |
| `NA` | 0.65 | Objective numerical aperture |
| `n_angles` | 8 | Number of illumination angles |
| `ri_contrast_scale` | 0.01 | RI contrast scaling factor |

### Illumination Geometry

8 LED positions uniformly distributed on a ring at NA = 0.65 (annular IDT).
Each LED approximates a plane wave with direction:

$$
k_x^{in} = \text{NA} \cdot \cos(2\pi m / 8), \quad k_y^{in} = \text{NA} \cdot \sin(2\pi m / 8), \quad m = 0, \ldots, 7
$$

The observations are reused experimental data, spatially cropped and averaged into detector pixels. No new simulated observations are generated.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| measurements | (1,74,128,128) | float64 | Aligned HAADF intensities, axes batch/angle/detector-y/detector-x, detector counts |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Electron energy | 200 | keV | STEM accelerating voltage |
| Convergence semi-angle | 9.6 | mrad | Electron-probe convergence |
| Probe current | 8-10 | pA | Reported acquisition range |
| Original nominal sampling | 0.71 | nm/pixel | Reported unbinned detector sampling |
| Detector averaging | 9 by 9 | original pixels | Arithmetic mean of each detector block |
| Nominal voxel sampling | 6.39 | nm | Original nominal pitch multiplied by nine |
| Angular sampling | -75 to 75, step 2; omit 23 and 25 | degree | Two unusable views removed; the array gives exact retained angles |
| Detector rays | 128 | rays/view/slice | Unit ray spacing and unit reconstruction pixel width |
| Spatial crop | rows and columns 2 through 1153 inclusive | original pixels | Fixed 1152-square aligned region before averaging |
| Tilt-axis direction | detector horizontal x | dimensionless | Horizontal slices have independent 2D geometry |
| Detector centers | r - 63.5 for r=0,...,127 | voxel | Symmetric ray offsets about the origin |
| Cross-section domain | [-64,64] on each coordinate | voxel | Square grid with centers at half-integers |
| Projection normal | (cos a, sin a) in (y,physical-depth) | dimensionless | Beam direction is (-sin a, cos a); a is converted from degrees |
| Boundary | zero outside reconstruction square | detector-count units | No periodic wraparound |
| Noise | unspecified | detector counts | No validated independent pixel-variance estimate |

The original sampling is nominal; the data do not support a more precise physical scale. Aligned measurements are supplied directly; alignment is not part of the requested inverse problem.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Measurement condition | Air-reference repeated THz time traces | — | Instrument-noise/drift experiment, without a material specimen inversion. |
| Acquisition date | 2017-03-20 | — | Author data record. |
| Repeated acquisitions | 50 | 1 | $M$; original filename order. |
| Native samples per trace | 267 | 1 | $N$; entire recorded window. |
| Sampling interval | 0.05003462406015038 | ps | $\Delta t$; mean native time-coordinate spacing. |
| Relative time origin | 0 | ps | First supplied sample; absolute time offset is absorbed by the waveform gauge. |
| Transimpedance gain | 5e7 | V/A | Original voltage divided by this gain yields current in amperes. |
| Public amplitude conversion | Original voltage × 1e12 / 5e7 | pA | Exact author-specified conversion. |
| Shift convention | $\mu(t-\eta)$ | — | Positive delay shifts a feature toward larger sample time. |
| Fourier boundary | Periodic, real transform on all 267 samples | — | Odd sample count has no separate Nyquist coefficient. |
| Drift gauge | First amplitude 1; first delay 0 | — | Fixes amplitude and delay nonidentifiability. |
| Sample-noise assumptions | Gaussian; independent conditional on drift and waveform | — | Variance depends on each scan's expected waveform and its derivative. |
| Noise parameters | Unknown and shared across all scans | — | Additive, multiplicative and timing-jitter amplitudes must all be inferred. |

references:
Generate synthetic data for ultrasound speed-of-sound tomography.

Creates a 128x128 speed-of-sound phantom with tissue-like inclusions,
converts to slowness perturbation relative to water background, computes
travel-time sinograms via the Radon transform, adds noise, and saves.

The forward model operates on the slowness perturbation
delta_s = s - s_water = 1/c - 1/c_water, which is zero outside the
object. This avoids artifacts from the circular reconstruction support
of the Radon transform.

travel-time sinograms via the Radon transform, adds noise, and saves.
